source_script: Six weeks ago I couldn't do a single pull-up. This band clips onto any doorframe in about ten seconds and gives you assisted resistance for pull-ups, rows, and stretches. I use it every morning before work and every night before bed. My arms and back feel stronger every single week. It folds flat so it travels with you anywhere. Thousands of people are using this exact band right now to build their first pull-up. It's not a gimmick, it's just smart resistance training you can do at home.
